newsitem.title: USA: Utilicorp, PECO launch energy marketing company.
newsitem.headline: Utilicorp, PECO launch energy marketing company.

text.p: Electricity utilities Utilicorp United Inc. and Peco Energy Co. said Tuesday they were launching a one-stop-shopping service for a variety of utilities.

A new jointly-owned company, EnergyOne L.L.C., will offer natural gas and electricity services, as well as AT&T Corp. residential communication services and ADT Ltd. home and business electronic security offerings.
EnergyOne, based in Kansas City, Mo., will obtain revenues from franchise, royalty and transaction fees from participating distributors and suppliers.
Utilicorp spokesman Jerry Cosley said deregulation of the electricity and natural gas industry gives utilities the opportunity to market products outside their normal territories.

EnergyOne will serve as a management clearing house responsible for developing relationships with suppliers, evaluating and selecting new products and services, and establishing competitive wholesale pricing mechanisms.
Participating utilities will serve as retail distributors of the products, drawing on EnergyOne's national marketing identity and support.
